prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the sandy Giza plateau with the great pyramids behind her, a smooth flat sand path and a standard-height stone doorway block at her side, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Ethiopian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, smooth warm-brown skin, a bold thick black liner drawn around the whole eye and winged slightly at the outer corner, warm gold and brown eyeshadow, strongly defined softly arched brows, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural warm rose-brown lip with a soft gloss, a serene, dignified expression, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in long thick box braids, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large platinum hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a gold cube-shaped block, a lead pyramid-shaped lump, a silver square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten gold rings. Extremely long coffin nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), wide silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric star filigree filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform stiletto ankle boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Pakistani person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a clean-cut young male model face with defined cheekbones, a firm jaw and strong straight brows, clean-shaven, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, smooth light-brown skin with a warm undertone, a calm easy look, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large brass hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a silver hammer head, a gold square-sided cowbell, a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, an iron barrel-shaped weight, a gold round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted diamond drop with a heavy rough tin a pyramid-shaped lump hanging at its end, and a single rose-gold bracelet. Extremely long oval nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous, a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below, but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Escher-inspired tessellation (a tessellating pattern of interlocking shapes that morph as they repeat), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense morphing tessellation filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
